summary: As of 2026-10-01, Carlos Ghosn is assessed as ADVERSE (97% confidence). The decisive facts are: French prosecutors issued an arrest warrant for him on 2026-09-29; he is being tried in absentia in the Paris corruption trial (Sept 2026) with prosecutors seeking a four‑year sentence and a €375,000 fine; he served as CEO of Nissan (June 2001‑April 2017) and Renault (from May 2005) and held chairmanship roles in the Alliance and Mitsubishi Motors.
